identified_defects.description: In driver solve_subproblem(), falling through to v[-1] on 2-component nodal U output interprets U2 displacement as U3 damage. The extractor can legitimately return 2-component results when U3 is unavailable. Subsequent clamping against d0 conceals this extraction failure rather than rejecting it.
identified_defects.remediation: Require exactly 15,559 unique physical-node records matching receiver mesh nodes. Reject missing, duplicated, unexpected, or nonfinite values. For the phase subproblem, accept only explicitly verified damage-output layouts: documented 1-component scalar damage field or complete >=3 component displacement field with damage in U3 (index 2). Reject 2-component output (U1, U2), mixed component counts, incomplete U3 coverage, and ambiguous extractor output. Never interpret v[-1] as damage by default. Fail closed before clipping to d0, updating damage field, or evaluating convergence. Add comprehensive unit and integration tests exercising valid U3, verified 1-component output, and rejection of all defect classes.
